title: Validate desktop operation requests
responsibility: Builds the allowed request shape for desktop operations and rejects invalid field values.

inputs.name: approvalPayload.value
inputs.description: An approval object with a version, up to 24 image hashes, contract hash and optional option o1 through o10. Hashes must be 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; version is v plus at least three digits, at most 20 characters.

inputs.name: threadPayload.x
inputs.description: Thread fields naming an entity and either a complete image anchor or null version, image hash, state and viewport. An unanchored thread must also have a null region. Optional design option is o1 through o10.

inputs.name: creationProject.value
inputs.description: The explicit project identity for a creation request: local- plus 64 hexadecimal characters, or a UUID-shaped identifier. Matching is case-insensitive.

inputs.name: creationPayload.x
inputs.description: A creation request with only intent, projectId, category, mode, provider, model, effort, text and optional designOptions. Requires create intent, plan mode, a catalog category and codex or claude provider.

inputs.name: runPayload.x
inputs.description: An existing-entity run request, or a creation request when intent is present. Existing runs need mode, approval or null, provider, model, effort or null, entity, thread and nonblank text up to 20,000 characters. Change needs approval and forbids a design-option count.

inputs.name: ipcPayload.channel
inputs.description: The operation name used to choose a payload shape. The caller is responsible for allowing known operations before this helper; unknown names can fall through to an entity-shaped payload.

inputs.name: ipcPayload.input
inputs.description: The untrusted operation input. Most operations require an object; project opening and provider listing ignore input and return null.

outputs.name: approvalPayload
outputs.description: A validated approval binding with version, hashes, contract hash and optional option. Unrecognized fields are omitted.

outputs.name: threadPayload
outputs.description: A validated thread request with only its entity, image-anchor values, region and optional option.

outputs.name: creationPayload
outputs.description: A validated creation request. Design count is omitted or a whole number from 1 to 10; effort is null or text. Unknown keys are refused.

outputs.name: runPayload
outputs.description: A validated run or creation request. Extra keys on an existing-entity run are omitted. Plan may omit its count; any supplied count must be 1–10.

outputs.name: ipcPayload
outputs.description: The validated operation-specific payload, retaining only selected fields. History pages must be integers 1–10,000; revision and image identifiers follow the shared patterns. No operation is executed.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws for invalid or missing fields, incomplete image anchors, a Change without approval or with design options, invalid creation identity or keys, invalid history pages, and shared field-validation failures.
